payout_quote: Open a Basic Business Checking account using promo code START200 by January 31, 2027. Maintain an average daily balance of $3,000 over your account's first few months. You'll earn up to $50 cashback per calendar month, up to $200 total.
steps: Open a new Axos Basic Business Checking account online using promo code START200 by January 31, 2027 (no minimum opening deposit required; EIN/formation docs needed).
Maintain an average daily balance of $3,000 over the account's first few months.
Earn up to $50 cashback per calendar month, up to $200 total, while the balance condition is met.
catches: Promo code START200 must be used at application; without it no bonus is earned.
Requires maintaining a $3,000 average daily balance over the first few months; months below the threshold earn no cashback.
Payout is dripped at up to $50 per calendar month (up to $200 total), not a lump sum.
Business documentation required (EIN, ownership agreements, business license, articles of incorporation/organization); sole proprietors can use SSN.
Bonus is taxable income (standard bank-bonus tax treatment); confirm on the account disclosures/1099.
biggest_catch: The $200 is paid as up to $50/month cashback and only for months you hold a $3,000 average daily balance; miss the balance in a month and you earn nothing that month. Promo code START200 is required and the offer ends 1/31/2027.
eligibility: New Axos Basic Business Checking customers; business entity with required formation documentation; promo code START200 at opening.
timing: Open by 1/31/2027 with promo code START200; maintain $3,000 average daily balance over the first few months; up to $50/month cashback, $200 total cap.
